title: Never seems to get hot enough
text: Never seems to get hot enough. The first time I used this on hot setting, it felt HOT. After 2 weeks, the hot setting feels almost like I set it on LOW. I keep unplugging it and turning it on again but it’s never been as good as the first time. It’s generous in size, soft and the control is easy to use. I just want it HOTTER.

product_metadata.title: iDOO Electric Blanket Throw, 10 Heating Levels & 1-10H Auto Off Heated Blanket, Ultra Soft Double-Side Flannel, Super Fast Heating Blanket 50"x 60", ETL Certified, HD Display, Gifts for Women, Grey
features: Warming Up In a Moment- 54FT High Quality PTC/NTC heating wires run throughout the electric blanket throw with larger coverage area to provide you with the maximum warmth up to 122°F, which is 20°F hotter than regular electric blankets. Double non-woven fabric distributes the heat evenly, you’ll enjoy the cozy warmth like a sunbath.
10 Heating Levels- iDOO heating blanket customizes the warmth you want in 10 heating levels (86°F-122°F). You’ll always obtain the most desired warmth, making it ideal for keeping out the cold.
10 Timer Settings- The auto-off timer of heated blanket throw can be set for 1-10 hours, perfect for staying cozy, warm, and safe as you doze off.

Safety Promise & Reliable Quality- Our electric throw certificated by ETL, FCC, PSE etc official Institutions, Improves the industry's common problems such as short service life and abnormal heating and so on. Before delivery, iDOO electric throw blanket been tested by product quality inspection team of 400+ people to ensure that you have the best product experience. If you have any problems with the product, please contact customer service as soon as possible, we will provide you with a satisfactory solution to ensure that you have no worries.

Energy Saving Technology- Using our heated throw and turning off the thermostat can save 70-85% a year on your heating bill (based on electric heated blanket size). Use it now and watch your savings climb. This is the best way to save money in winter.

Machine Washable & Ideal valentines Gifts - Disconnect the electric blanket throw from the controller till it fully cools down, and launder it in a machine with cold water on low cycle. Do not connect to power again until the blanket is fully dried. iDOO Heating Blanket is a great Mother's Day gift for Mom or a birthday gift for Dad.
